# who-iris-translations

The gettext side of who-iris's own strings, one directory per target locale: the `glossary/who-iris--who-terms` catalogues that translate this instance's WHO terms. Moved here from cat-harness/translations/ on the owner's ruling of 2026-10-04, "move things to semantically appropriate place" (bean riit): a scheme's translations sit with the instance whose terms they translate.

Part of [WHO IRIS](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `who-iris-translations`, holding `translation-sources`.
